chunks: 2961 - And he, peace be upon him, said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has not created on the earth any spot more beloved to Him than the Ka'bah, nor any more honored before Him than it. And for its sake Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made the four sacred months sacred in His Book.
"the day He created the heavens and the earth"
Three of them are consecutive for hajj, and one separate month is for 'umrah: Rajab.

key_terms.الْأَشْهُرَ الْحُرُمَ: the four sacred months made inviolable by Allah
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, for which three consecutive sacred months are designated
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ: 'umrah, for which Rajab is singled out here
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the most honored and beloved place on earth in this narration
key_terms.رَجَبٌ: Rajab, the separate sacred month mentioned for 'umrah
key_terms.يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ: the Qur'anic phrase indicating the divine origin of this sacred designation from creation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the sanctity of the Ka'bah and the four sacred months?
ai.summary: This hadith states the unique sanctity and honor of the Ka'bah as the most beloved spot on earth to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. It links the four sacred months to that sanctity, noting that three consecutive months relate to hajj, while Rajab is singled out for 'umrah. The wording also echoes the Qur'anic basis for the sacred months.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Allah (swt), the Exalted, has not created on the earth a spot more beloved to Him than the Ka'bah, nor more honored by Him. For its sake, Allah (swt), the Exalted, sanctified the four sacred months in His Book
'on the day He created the heavens and the earth'

(Surah At-Tawbah 9:36).
Three of these months are consecutive for Hajj, and one is designated specifically for Umrah, which is Rajab."
